yarn-troppo.meaning: All steps, code and facts survive, but a few glosses shift the technical sense: "The client locks up each number with the committee public key, encrypts it" makes one step sound like two, and "Cargo rebuilds the program server from scratch" claims a full rebuild where the original says it compiles again. Asides like "Like totting up a stack of sealed envelopes without opening a single one." and "or you'll get some very odd answers" hang off the original.
yarn-troppo.sense: Most terms fit ("knocked over the [Quick Start]", "don't spit the dummy", "every man and his dog", "Have a geek at"), but "like a bouncer who's knocked off for the night" muddles its image: a bouncer who has knocked off isn't there to wave anyone through.
yarn-troppo.authenticity: Sounds like an Australian dev talking: "Righto, here's the go.", "give `Ctrl+C` a whack in its terminal", "Easy as.", "that's a yarn for another page".
yarn-troppo.register: Heavier than level 4, with frequent asides and jokes: "Double the fun.", "It's still expecting 5, poor thing", "it'll be in for a shock now", "Not bad for a few lines of Rust." No swearing, within dad level.
yarn-troppo.tone: The tutorial stays instructive, but the jokiness ("instead of boring old a + b", "so if that's not you, off you pop") pushes a precise reference toward banter.
yarn-troppo.flow: Reads easily aloud: "Everything else in the template's basically a delivery driver, ferrying ciphertexts to this function and carting its result off to the committee."
yarn-troppo.variety: Varied throughout: "knocked over", "off you pop", "humming away", "give `Ctrl+C` a whack", "spit the dummy", "every man and his dog", "Have a geek at"; "Track down this line" twice is the template's own repetition.
yarn-troppo.essence: Recognisably the Hello World tutorial with its steps and code intact, though the banter makes it feel more like a mate's walkthrough than reference docs.

yarn-dinkum.meaning: Every step and fact survives: "Bump the expected value from 5 to 10", "keep 2 × (a + b) under 100", "waves through every receipt on the local chain". "Job done." is colour.
yarn-dinkum.sense: Terms fit: "getting a squiz at them", "punch in 5 and 3", "Have a geek at", "It hasn't got a clue what the computation does".
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural, if more general colloquial English than Australian: "Heads up: this test needs a CLI", "carting its result off to the committee".
yarn-dinkum.register: Lighter than level 4: friendly and casual but with few distinctly Aussie terms beyond "squiz" and "Have a geek at"; many lines plain ("Cargo should print `test tests::test ... ok`.").
yarn-dinkum.tone: Keeps the tutorial's clear, instructive tone in a friendlier voice: "If the test fails, go back and check your `fhe_processor` against the code in the step before."
yarn-dinkum.flow: Reads smoothly: "On the input step you'll see `Ready to compute: 2 × (5 + 3) = ?`, and on the results step, `2 × (5 + 3) = 16`. Job done."
yarn-dinkum.variety: Some range ("fires them off", "carting", "squiz", "geek", "Heads up"), limited by how little slang there is.
yarn-dinkum.essence: Unmistakably the tutorial, steps and reference sections intact.

unharnessed.meaning: Every step survives; additions are colour: "no dramas", "Bewdy.", "the operator panics and spits the dummy". The LinkCard text "Check your inputs and verify proofs" keeps "Validate inputs".
unharnessed.sense: Terms fit: "already knocked over the [Quick Start]", "lugs its result across to the committee", "it can't have a squiz at them", "If the test falls over", "Find which file to fiddle with".
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural Australian throughout: "The function doesn't need any new imports, no dramas.", "Bewdy.", "the operator panics and spits the dummy".
unharnessed.register: Level 4 weight: Aussie terms spread through prose and callouts ("`ciphertexts` dishes out", "2 × (a + b) has gotta be less than 100", "stashes a commitment") without yarn asides. No swearing.
unharnessed.tone: Keeps the instructive tone: "Any change to the program changes that identity, so compile and deploy again."
unharnessed.flow: Reads smoothly: "The rest of the template just ferries ciphertexts over to this function and lugs its result across to the committee."
unharnessed.variety: Varied: "knocked over", "ferries", "lugs", "dishes out", "squiz", "no dramas", "Bewdy", "spits the dummy", "stashes"; "Have a look at" twice.
unharnessed.essence: Unmistakably the tutorial, retold in an Aussie voice.
